YiSi software - Semantic machine translation evaluation metric - National Research Council Canada
s: YiSiFootnote 1 is open-source software that evaluates the accuracy of meaning in output sentences produced by machine translation systems. It uses datasets that contain word embeddings to estimate the relationships of meaning between words, in order to assign an accuracy score from 0-100 for each translated sentence.
